annotations.exact_quote: Many problems can be characterized by the task of recovering the low-rank and sparse components of a given matrix.

annotations.exact_quote: This paper studies the recovery task in the general settings that only a fraction of entries of the matrix can be observed and the observation is corrupted by both impulsive and Gaussian noise.
